title: Model 2 windage calibration on Putman GPS mat tracks
scope: Wind-only and current-plus-wind drift endpoint errors for four natural Sargassum mat tracks, used to calibrate the windage coefficient.
summary: On four natural mat GPS tracks (2018), a wind-only windage near 0.02 beat the frozen 0.005 coefficient and persistence. Leave-one-track-out median endpoint error at 24 h was 11.59 km (n=47) versus 15.67 km for the frozen coefficient and 17.54 km for persistence; at 48 h, 28.67 km (n=22) versus 35.53 km and 35.99 km; at 6 h, 4.01 km (n=203) versus 4.66 km and 4.91 km.

metrics.name: 24 h LOTO wind-only median error (km)
metrics.provenance: Leave-one-track-out, windage chosen on the other three tracks; n=47 segments.

metrics.name: 24 h frozen-windage median error (km)
metrics.provenance: Windage 0.005, pooled over all tracks; n=47.

limitations: Only four tracks near one region and season; segments within a track are correlated, so the effective sample is far smaller than the segment counts.
Frozen and persistence rows are pooled, not leave-one-out.
Daily-mean reanalysis currents limit the current-plus-wind variants.
Endpoint distance on observed mat tracks is not map overlap and not coastal-arrival skill.
This is a calibration study. It is not the separately announced sub-kilometre St Kitts feasibility benchmark and does not complete it.
